name: mixed
description: Several topics in one conversation: follow-up questions, a question for another agent asked in the middle of a booking or registration, a booking right after a question about one animal, cancel then ask, six topics in a row, and a change of script mid-conversation. 20 per language. Bookings and registrations never get the final 'yes', so nothing is saved.
facts_note: Same farm as layers 1-2 (f-001): goat 14, buffalo 16 (Mehsana 5, Nili-Ravi 5), sheep 7, chicken 7, cow 9 (Kankrej 3), total 53. GAURI and MOTI = Sirohi goats, KAALI = Jamunapari goat, LAKSHMI = Murrah buffalo, BIJLI = Nili-Ravi buffalo, RAJA = Kankrej cow. Dates use placeholders counted from now in IST (see evals/run.py).
